description: This file defines a Dagger Hilt module that provides dependency injection setup for the Room database and its DAOs in an Android application. It configures the database instance with destructive migration fallback and exposes DAO providers for injection.

classes.name: DatabaseModule
classes.description: A Dagger module that provides Room database and DAO instances for dependency injection.

methods.name: provideDb
methods.description: Provides a singleton instance of the StealthGuardDatabase configured with destructive migration fallback.

methods.name: provideHiddenDao
methods.description: Provides the HiddenAppDao from the database.

methods.name: provideLockedDao
methods.description: Provides the LockedAppDao from the database.

methods.name: provideLockRuleDao
methods.description: Provides the LockRuleDao from the database.
